description: This file defines the ThemeService class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing theme-related functionalities such as retrieving theme images, variables, and URLs, as well as handling cache operations and generating CSS variables. It interacts with DAO classes, utilizes traits for caching and ETag generation, and encapsulates logic for theming in the HR management application.

classes.name: ThemeService
classes.description: A service class managing theme-related functionalities including image retrieval, theme variables, cache handling, and URL generation for theme assets within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: getThemeDao
methods.description: Retrieves the ThemeDao instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getScssHelper
methods.description: Retrieves the ScssHelper instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getImageETag
methods.description: Fetches the ETag for a specified theme image (client_logo, client_banner, login_banner) from cache.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the theme image object for a specified key from cache, fetching from DAO if not cached.

methods.name: getImageETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Fetches the ETag and image data, populating cache if necessary.

methods.name: getCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns the current theme variables as an array, fetching from cache or DAO.

methods.name: showSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Indicates whether social media icons should be shown, based on theme configuration.

methods.name: getDerivedCssVariables
methods.description: Generates a set of CSS variables based on theme variables, including color manipulations.

methods.name: getClientLogoURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the client logo image, considering cache and versioning.

methods.name: getClientBannerURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the client banner image.

methods.name: getLoginBannerURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the login banner image.
